【原视频简介】
From bouncing an egg soaked in glacial acetic acid to growing dendritic tin metal crystals using raw electric current, here are 6 fascinating chemistry experiments broken down step-by-step with the science behind every reaction!

⚠️ DISCLAIMER & SAFETY:
These experiments involve concentrated acids, strong bases (sodium hydroxide), and high-heat combustion. Always wear proper PPE (safety goggles, lab coat, and chemical-resistant gloves) and conduct high-fume or exothermic reactions in a well-ventilated area or chemical fume hood.

Which reaction was your favorite? Let me know in the comments below, hit like if you enjoyed the transformations, and subscribe for more deep-dive chemistry builds!
